description: Varuna Lake in Mysuru offers a variety of water-based games and activities through Outback Adventures. These include jetskiing, kayaking, speedboat rides, banana boat rides, bumper rides, sofa rides, and more. Outback Cafe, located on the lake, provides a lakeside dining experience.
